description: This file contains the PHP class 'Coupon' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Extension\Opencart\Report'. The class extends a base model class and provides methods to fetch coupon-related data and statistics, such as getCoupons() and getTotalCoupons().

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A model class for handling coupon report data, including retrieval of coupon lists and totals.

methods.name: getCoupons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of coupons along with usage statistics, filtered by date range, and supports pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCoupons
methods.description: Returns the total count of coupons matching given filter criteria, typically for pagination purposes.
